The '''Mondropolon language''' is a [[West Manus languages|West Manus language]] spoken by approximately 300 people on north-central [[Manus Island]], [[Manus Province]] of [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref name=e25/> Its speakers also use [[Kurti language|Kurti]].<ref name=e25/> It has [[subject–verb–object|SVO word order]].<ref name=e25/>
